spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on four legs against a plain off-white background. It has the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a large brown bear, but most of its body is covered by a glossy, dark reddish-brown segmented exoskeleton. A large domed carapace of overlapping transverse bands covers the back from behind the neck to the base of the tail, with additional large smooth plates over the shoulders and hips and smaller overlapping plates down the outer sides of all four limbs. The chest, belly, throat and inner surfaces of the limbs show lighter beige, ribbed and pitted segmented plating between the dark plates and the brown fur. The head, lower legs and paws remain furry, and a short segmented tail extends from the rear.

spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal chimera shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with the overall body shape, fur, and proportions of a brown bear but extensively covered in glossy, beetle-like exoskeletal armor. The head, ears, muzzle, and paws are distinctly bear-like with dense brown fur, while the back, shoulders, hips, chest, and outer surfaces of all four limbs are overlaid with shiny, dark reddish-brown segmented plates. The underside and inner limbs show lighter tan, ribbed plating. A single glossy dark horn projects from the forehead between the ears, and a narrow segmented tail extends from the rear. The animal stands on all four paws with claws visible, and the armor has a hard, varnished appearance with visible segmentation and sutures.
